text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(I should probably fine-tune my 
self-training routine a bit more.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Judging from the training data,\nfor a 
while, I should focus on strength and 
endurance—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I don't need any support. I won't be a 
burden to anyone, and—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
That will save you the trouble too, so 
wouldn't it be more convenient?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...What's with that look? You should be 
glad you have one less hassle to deal 
with.)
